text_description: Full-length runway look combining a pale icy blue button-front shirt with a sculptural black mini skirt and brown boots. The shirt is tucked in and cut with a neat pointed collar, long slightly loose sleeves, buttoned cuffs, and a straight central placket; the front chest area is decorated with vertical ruffled or lace-like strips and small light-catching embellishments running from the collar down toward the waist. Over it sits a high-waisted black wrap-style skirt with a pronounced asymmetric silhouette: the waist is close to the body, while the skirt flares outward in stiff, folded panels, with a longer diagonal front panel dropping on the wearer’s left side and a much shorter cutaway on the right exposing the thigh. The skirt surface appears textured with quilted or embroidered diagonal patterning and a subtly scalloped or lace-edged trim along parts of the hem. Styling includes tan-brown ankle boots with a substantial sole and visible gold chain/hardware across the front, plus a small grey textured handbag carried low in one hand, with a short handle/strap and dark edging. The overall mood is polished but off-kilter, pairing a crisp embellished shirt with a voluminous asymmetric black bottom and equestrian-toned hardware boots.
